name: sop
description: Standard operating procedure skills for repeatable engineering and analysis workflows, including review request submission and falsifiable scientific analysis.

interface.longDescription: SOP collects standard operating procedure skills for repeatable engineering and analysis tasks. It includes workflows for opening review requests from the current branch and for analyzing surprising empirical phenomena with falsifiable hypotheses, explicit evidence status, and experiment designs.
defaultPrompt: Use submit-mr to open a merge request or pull request
Create an MR or PR for the current branch
Use scientific-analyst to analyze an unexpected benchmark result
